title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Added Installments for Larger Past-Due Balances
content:
On a payment arrangement for a past-due Repair and Emergency Service Calls balance, a larger balance adds installments to the number of installments.

**Balance for this purpose.** The balance owing for this purpose is worked out from the invoice lines: the call's charge lines, less its discount, coverage-credit and payment lines, plus its refund lines.

**Rule.**

| Balance owing worked out from the invoice lines | Installments added |
|---|---|
| 1,000 dollars (1000.00) or more | 2 |
| 500 dollars or more but under 1,000 dollars | 1 |
| Under 500 dollars | None |

In the words of the rule: a balance owing of 1,000 dollars or more adds two installments to the number of installments, a balance owing of 500 dollars or more but under 1,000 dollars adds one installment, and a smaller balance adds none.

## Worked example (hypothetical invoice)

| Lines | Amount |
|---|---|
| Charge lines | $1,240.00 |
| Discount lines | less $124.00 |
| Coverage-credit lines | less $0.00 |
| Payment lines | less $100.00 |
| Refund lines | plus $0.00 |
| Balance owing for this purpose | $1,016.00, which adds 2 installments |

## Boundaries

- $1,000.00 adds 2. $999.99 adds 1.
- $500.00 adds 1. $499.99 adds none.
